title: ½ Price Connoisseur Ice Cream Varieties 1L $6.50 @ Woolworths
body:
Deal: ½ Price Connoisseur Ice Cream Varieties 1L $6.50 @ Woolworths

[darkdinkum] RIP Cafe Grande :(((
To our Café Grande lovers, we’re sorry to share the sad news…​
Due to ongoing supply issues with the hero ingredient Grand Marnier syrup in our Café Grande 1L Tub, we’re no longer able to produce the flavour you know and love. These challenges are outside of our control and, as a result, we've had to make the difficult decision to remove Café Grande from our range.​
We know how much you love this flavour, so we completely understand the disappointment this may cause.​
Rest assured, our team are working hard to find a coffee flavour alternative for the future. 🤎
[87percent] Yeah, was wondering what happened to the coffee flavoured one!
[oatmatcha] I know it's not the same, but vanilla goes pretty well with a shot of coffee poured over it.
[Ventak] Coinciding with this is Haagen Dazs also discontinuing its coffee flavoured ice cream - I see them on clearance at a permanent half price now.
[jcon] Dolly Parton, Tim Curry and now this ???
Not cool 2026, not cool.
[mmd] I remember the good days where $5 was half price
[dantrax77] I felt like it's gone up heaps - but went back & checked…
Considering it was $5 in 2017 when half price, $1.50 increase in 9 years isn't too bad compared to pretty much everything else!
[tenpercent] Did you check the ingredients?
Connoisseur Ice Cream did used to be delectable. Not so much now. Pretty mid. I'm assuming they've enshitified it in some way.
[liam2040] the slippery slope towards iced confectionery.
[steviewonder67] Oh no, I love Cafe Grande.
Sad news.
I used to buy the Tubs for $4 1/2 price and buy three. Not anymore.
[FXx] Probably a good thing, for your health that is.
[welcomeUniverseWorld] There was a time when I was almost addicted to it. I used to have it nearly every night, but then I randomly stopped. I don’t crave it at all anymore. I wonder if there’s something in it that causes such strong cravings.
[immeen04] Why did they discontinue Chocolate brownie Custard!? It has been nearly six months removed from the shelves
[immeen04] It’s the one flavour that sells out most often and yet they discontinued it!
